description: The finite binary word code is injective, encodes the empty word by 1, and for length r lies between 2^r and 2^(r+1)−1.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode_spec :
  Function.Injective Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode ∧
    Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode [] = 1 ∧
      ∀ (w : List Bool),
        2 ^ w.length ≤ Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode w ∧
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.binaryWordCode w < 2 ^ (w.length + 1)
